title: Admin List view: add newest/oldest sort control, and de-emphasize the past-bookings toggle to reduce button density
tech: React + TypeScript frontend only -- no backend or API change needed
keyConstraints: Follow-up to task 033 (already shipped, commit 8d226f4 -- hides past bookings by default via a showPast toggle at AdminDashboard.tsx around line 197-204, plus an empty-state hint when the filter hides everything). Confirmed by reading the current AdminDashboard.tsx and backend/src/services/bookingService.ts: the admin bookings list is returned by the backend in a fixed order (`ORDER BY b.start_at`, ascending/soonest-first, no query param for direction), and the frontend already fetches the full matching set for the selected statusFilter with no date restriction -- so a sort-direction control can be added purely client-side over the already-fetched array, exactly like task 033's past/upcoming filter, with no backend change. Two independent asks from Ville after seeing task 033 shipped: (1) SORT: add a control letting the masseur flip the visible list between newest-first and oldest-first by start_at (raw ISO field on AdminBooking, never start_at_local/end_at_local -- those are formatted display strings, not sortable). Default to the current effective order (ascending/soonest-first) so nothing changes until the masseur touches it. Sort must compose with both the existing statusFilter and task 033's showPast toggle -- e.g. showing past+upcoming confirmed bookings sorted newest-first. (2) DENSITY: the List view's filter section (`<section aria-label="Suodata varauksia">`) already renders the 4 status-filter pill buttons (STATUS_FILTERS.map, btn/btn-primary/btn-secondary + aria-pressed) plus task 033's showPast toggle using the exact same full-size pill-button styling (`className={btn ${showPast ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-secondary'}}`) -- on top of the view-mode row above it (Varaukset/Kalenteri/Saatavuus/Palvelut, also full pill buttons), this is now three-plus rows of same-weight buttons on one screen. Ville's explicit feedback: too many buttons. Restyle the existing showPast toggle from a full pill button to small, lower-visual-weight text (e.g. a compact text-button/link style) -- keep the aria-pressed semantics and all existing behavior (label still flips 'Näytä menneet varaukset' / 'Piilota menneet varaukset'), only the visual treatment changes. Checked frontend/src/styles/base.css: there is no existing lightweight/text-button CSS class in this codebase today (only .btn, .btn-primary, .btn-secondary, .btn-back, .btn-block) -- Architect should design a small new class (e.g. .btn-text or similar) rather than repurposing an existing pill-button class, and consider whether it's reusable enough to apply to the new sort control too so this doesn't reintroduce the same density problem with a second new pill button. The new sort control should also be compact -- a single small toggle/link that flips direction and indicates current state, not a pair of new full-size buttons.
description: Two related polish items for the admin List view's filter area: add a compact control to sort the visible bookings by date (newest-first or oldest-first), and restyle task 033's past-bookings toggle from a full pill button to small, lightweight text so the already button-dense filter row doesn't get more crowded.
acceptanceCriteria: A compact sort control lets the masseur switch the visible list between newest-first and oldest-first by start_at, defaulting to the current effective order (ascending/soonest-first) so behavior is unchanged until the masseur touches it
Sort composes correctly with both the existing statusFilter and the showPast toggle from task 033 -- switching either one preserves the current sort direction
The sort uses the raw start_at ISO field, never start_at_local/end_at_local

The existing showPast toggle (task 033) keeps its exact current behavior and Finnish labels ('Näytä menneet varaukset' / 'Piilota menneet varaukset') and aria-pressed semantics, but is restyled to small, low-visual-weight text -- no longer matching the full-size btn-primary/btn-secondary pill-button treatment used by the view-mode and status-filter rows
The new sort control is similarly compact -- not a new pair of full-size pill buttons

New/updated test coverage in AdminDashboard.test.tsx for the sort control (both directions, composes with statusFilter and showPast) and updated assertions for the showPast toggle's new styling if any existing test asserts on its className

No regression to existing AdminDashboard tests (status filter switching, showPast toggle behavior and empty-state hint from task 033, Confirm/Decline/Cancel actions, view-mode switching) -- run the full existing suite, not just an assumed-safe subset
npm test, npm run build, npm run lint, and tsc --noEmit all pass in frontend/ (backend should be unaffected since no backend files change)
relevantFilePaths: frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx (showPast toggle around line 197-204, filter section around line 185-205)
frontend/src/styles/base.css (existing .btn/.btn-primary/.btn-secondary classes -- read-only reference; no lightweight text-button class exists yet, Architect should design one)
frontend/src/api/types.ts (AdminBooking -- read-only reference, confirms start_at raw ISO field already exists)
securityConsiderations: None -- purely client-side display sorting/styling over data already returned by the existing authenticated GET /admin/bookings endpoint; no new data exposure, no new API surface.
